requirement: On the local stand an email address is enough to sign in: the page fills the code it shows and sends it once

oracle.invariant: S1: one /login, then exactly one /verify with the shown code, then the page goes to next. S2: one /verify with that code on load, then next. S3: only /login; nothing is verified without a person.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
